::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Aug 2d 1878  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 64-65
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

Will you let [Miss Carter Smith](people/person_263.qmd) as before order some of the [Scripture Readings](cmy_books/cmybook_87.qmd) at the price to the trade.

I wish [Clay](organizations/other_173.qmd) would finish off [that last volume](cmy_books/cmybook_129.qmd). He always sends me a proof when I am busy. I send more copy. Then he stops for another 3 months. I have now finished within about 12 chapters, but I shall be in Devonshire after Tuesday for 6 weeks, however a letter here will be sent on

Yours truly
C M Yonge
